gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Woodgod has lowercase letters that climb nearly to the capitals, giving every word a vintage, shouting stance. Yet Noto Sans Thaana handles the quieter work, with wide channels into each counter that keep text approachable.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-thai: Woodgod's lowercase stretches almost to the height of its capitals, which gives the headline a commanding, vintage bluster. Noto Sans Thai answers with lowercase swollen like glass beads, rounded and left open.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-thai-loo: Woodgod pushes a wide channel into every bowl and lifts its lowercase close to cap height, a loud vintage voice. Noto Sans Thai Looped stays clear.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Rounded, open and inviting, this body face fills its lines gently. Woodgod does its best work as a tall, commanding vintage display, while Noto Sans Tifinagh simply carries the words with bowls that swell like inflated shapes.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap and lets a dominant x-height fill each line. Woodgod stays loud above it.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Woodgod looks vintage and commanding, with tall lowercase. Its display swagger is what it does best, while Noto Sans Ugaritic lets open mouths, like chalk arcs left unjoined, carry the quieter reading.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-vai: Woodgod's lowercase nearly reaches its capitals, and a wide channel runs into every bowl, for a vintage shout. Noto Sans Vai forms solid blocks.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Open throats on a, c, e and s make this body face read cleanly, with hardly any step down from capital to lowercase. Noto Sans Vithkuqi keeps that modern tone beneath Woodgod, whose tall vintage lowercase supplies the command.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Woodgod's lowercase rises almost to the capitals, with a wide channel into every bowl, a vintage voice made for big, short lines. Noto Sans Wancho hulks below.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-noto-sans-warang-c: Noto Sans Warang Citi forms words as solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter. Woodgod, by contrast, handles the commanding, vintage display work, while Noto Sans Warang Citi holds the text.
